Notes: The Headstrings Collective Monday Muse (feat. Scott Baston / Bill Jarrett and special guests) * A New Lineup Every Week* Mondays Charleston Pour House | Main Stage 5pm doors /6:30pm shows 2 x sets FREE SHOWS Lineup: Scott Baston Bill Jarrett Corey Stephens Ethan Hamlin Danny Circharo Jon Joiner The Headstrings Collective The Headstrings Collective is the latest creative project from longtime friends and collaborators Scott Baston and Bill Jarrett. Known for their years together in the beloved Southern jam band Moonshine Still (1996–2007) and later in St. Francis, Scott and Bill have spent decades weaving soulful songs and sharing stages with an array of incredible musicians across the country. With The Headstrings Collective, they bring that same spirit of collaboration, connection, and musical exploration to a new home: Monday Muse on the Charleston Pour House deck. Beginning this September, Scott and Bill will host a rotating lineup of talented musicians each week, creating a one-of-a-kind experience where no two nights are ever the same. At its core, The Headstrings Collective is about community—celebrating friendship, creativity, and the joy of live music.
